transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. I've called this roundtable together because we have a rental robotic palletizer available for installation in Bay 7 before next week's peak-season packaging run. The rental quotation already covers the palletizer, installation support, and operator training, and Bay 7 has adequate access for delivery. I have the authority to approve this rental and set the conditions for deploying the equipment, but before I do, I want to hear from each of you -- maintenance, safety, quality, and production training -- on any requirements or concerns you have. Let's go through them one at a time so I can set the right deployment conditions.
